prompt: Write only Python code. Define merge_sorted_lists(list1, list2) that merges two sorted lists into a single sorted list without calling sort. No docstring.
text:
```python
def merge_sorted_lists(list1, list2):
    merged = []
    i, j = 0, 0
    while i < len(list1) and j < len(list2):
        if list1[i] <= list2[j]:
            merged.append(list1[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            merged.append(list2[j])
            j += 1
    merged.extend(list1[i:])
    merged.extend(list2[j:])
    return merged
```
